8	class ClientRegistry:
9	    """Manages connected WebSocket clients with thread-safe operations."""

11	    def __init__(self):
12	        self._clients: Dict[str, Any] = {}
13	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
14	
15	    def register(self, websocket: Any) -> str:
16	        """Register a new client and return its unique ID."""
17	        client_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
18	        with self._lock:
19	            self._clients[client_id] = websocket
20	        return client_id
21	
22	    def unregister(self, client_id: str) -> None:
23	        """Unregister a client by ID."""
24	        with self._lock:
25	            self._clients.pop(client_id, None)
26	
27	    def get_client(self, client_id: str) -> Optional[Any]:
28	        """Get a specific client by ID."""
29	        with self._lock:
30	            return self._clients.get(client_id)
31	
32	    def get_all_clients(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
33	        """Get a snapshot of all connected clients."""
34	        with self._lock:
35	            return dict(self._clients)
36	
37	    def get_client_count(self) -> int:
38	        """Get count of connected clients."""

  - `GET /channels/{name}/subscribers` - returns subscriber IDs for a channel
